sentences.jp: 病室の窓の外で、雨が灰色の街にゆっくりと交ざっていた。

sentences.jp: 小川東也が最後に自分の足で立ったのはいつだろうと、彼はぼんやり天井を見上げながら考えた。

sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.en: While no one among his relatives mourned him or even began discussing the construction of a grave, only Haruka poured all her savings into Dr. Satō's final treatment, a fact that Tōya had been told repeatedly in the fading dream.

sentences.en: Three years ago, he was calculating in the cold corner of his mind what he could have given back to this woman.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.ruby: だが今は違[ちが]う、と彼[かれ]は思った。

sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.en: In the depths of sleep, he descended to a place so deep that he could hardly comprehend it, and from there, he grasped something and returned.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.en: "If they know I'm alive, both my brother and my cousin will be on guard. However, if they believe I've turned to ash as planned, they will surely reveal their true colors."
